papers.title: 3D printed titanium anodized effects on human gingival fibroblasts response and bacterial colonization: a dual approach
papers.abstract: Abstract Mucointegration is as important as osseointegration to ensure the survival of implant-supported prosthesis. Indeed, effective soft tissue integration (STI) prevents the appearance of complication through bacterial dissemination. To optimize STI, electrochemical anodization can be used to nanostructure the trans-gingival part of the prosthetic component. Moreover, Selective Laser Melting (SLM) is a new 3D-manufacturing technique that enables the production of customized implant-supported prosthesis with complex geometry. Objective The aim of this study is to evaluate the effect of a SLM manufactured and anodized Ti6Al4V surface on the behaviour of both, human gingival fibroblasts and oral bacteria. Method SLM-Ti6Al4V discs were polished and anodized with defined parameters to obtain nanotubes (NTs) with specific morphology. Surface characterization was assessed through surface topography and wettability. Human gingival Fibroblasts were cultured, and cell morphology was observed by SEM at day 7. Proliferation, viability (day 1,4,7) and adhesion (6 h and 36 h) were analyzed. Then immunofluorescence and RT-qPCR were used to detect the distribution and the gene expression of vinculin at 48 h. An early colonizer (Streptococcus gordonii) was used for a parallel evaluation of bacteriological adhesion. Results SLM-ANO-Ti6Al4V showed similar performances in terms of cytotoxicity, compared with a machined and polished titanium surface currently used in clinics. Interestingly, cell adhesion was enhanced on anodized SLM surfaces, with a difference in the distribution of focal adhesion plaques in HGFs, while biofilm formation of S. gordonii was not affected by anodization. Significance SLM anodized surface showed promising ability to promote STI while controlling bacterial adhesion.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是SLM Ti-6Al-4V经阳极氧化处理后的生物学响应，而非力学或疲劳性能，与L1方向不相关。
llm.why_not_core: Paper focuses on biological response (fibroblast adhesion, bacterial colonization) of anodized SLM Ti-6Al-4V, with no mechanical or fatigue testing, modeling, or characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估阳极氧化SLM Ti-6Al-4V表面促进软组织整合和控制细菌粘附的能力
summary_zh.method: 对SLM Ti-6Al-4V盘进行抛光、阳极氧化处理，表征表面形貌与润湿性，培养人牙龈成纤维细胞并分析粘附、增殖，以及细菌粘附实验
summary_zh.result: 阳极氧化表面细胞粘附增强，焦点粘附斑分布变化，且不影响细菌生物膜形成
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞和细菌实验验证

summary_en.motivation: This study evaluates the effect of an anodized SLM-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V surface on human gingival fibroblast behavior and oral bacterial colonization to improve soft tissue integration.
summary_en.method: SLM Ti-6Al-4V discs were polished and anodized to produce nanotube morphology; surface topography and wettability were characterized, and human gingival fibroblasts were cultured for proliferation, viability, and adhesion assays alongside bacterial adhesion tests with Streptococcus gordonii.
summary_en.result: Anodized SLM surfaces enhanced fibroblast adhesion and altered focal adhesion plaque distribution without affecting bacterial biofilm formation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture (SEM, proliferation, RT-qPCR) and bacterial adhesion experiments.

papers.title: Mechanical Nitriding of Titanium and Its Alloys as a Feedstock for the Additive Manufacturing of Functionally Graded Materials
papers.abstract: This work focuses on obtaining a titanium nitride coating on the surfaces of titanium and its alloy powders using a novel method, self-shearing reactive milling, under a nitrogen pressure of 50 bar. The Ti, Ti6Al4V, and Ti-5553 spherical powders were milled for up to 10 h at ambient temperature without grinding balls. As a result of the experiments, a thin, brittle TiN coating formed on the powders' surfaces. The cross-sections of the milled powders reveal that the TiN layer thickness is in the nanometer range (about 500 nm). By analyzing the sequence of X-ray diffraction patterns, it is evident that only for the Ti6Al4V powder milled for 10 h, two peaks are observed that can be attributed to a TiN phase. On the other hand, Raman spectroscopy revealed characteristic TiN spectra even for samples collected at the initial stage of self-shearing reactive milling. An important aspect of the experiment was the preservation of the spherical shape of the milled powders, which makes them a potential feedstock for additive manufacturing of functionally graded biomaterials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V粉末的机械氮化处理，但未涉及增材制造后的力学或疲劳性能，因此与L1方向核心内容无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not provide any mechanical or fatigue characterization of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on powder surface modification for feedstock development.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发新型机械氮化方法，在钛合金粉末表面形成TiN涂层作为增材制造功能梯度材料的原料。
summary_zh.method: 采用自剪切反应球磨法，在50 bar氮气下对Ti、Ti6Al4V、Ti-5553粉末进行机械氮化。
summary_zh.result: 成功在粉末表面形成约500 nm厚TiN涂层，XRD仅检测到Ti6Al4V的TiN峰，但拉曼光谱显示所有样品均有TiN特征。
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD、拉曼光谱和SEM对涂层进行表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a novel mechanical nitriding method to form titanium nitride coatings on titanium alloy powders as feedstock for additive manufacturing of functionally graded materials.
summary_en.method: Self-shearing reactive milling under 50 bar nitrogen pressure was applied to spherical Ti, Ti6Al4V, and Ti-5553 powders without grinding balls.
summary_en.result: A thin (approximately 500 nm) brittle TiN coating was formed, with XRD only detecting TiN peaks for Ti6Al4V after 10 h, while Raman spectroscopy revealed TiN signals even in early stages.
summary_en.validation: Coatings were characterized by XRD, Raman spectroscopy, and SEM cross-sectional analysis.
